rules.question: What is a path's running score, given its six score categories?
rules.note: A running score built by adding category fields by hand next to the owner. This catches only the hand sum; a seventh category arrives under a new name, so no text search catches a category missing from the sum, and emit_path's runtime check in src/search/engine.cpp is the guard for that. Decided by: concept audit M30 (D114, task F7)
